title: Superpower accordion
description: Question-and-answer rows that open in place, built on native details/summary (no JavaScript). Line: hairline-separated FAQ rows with a thin plus that turns into a cross. Soft: zinc-50 boxes with a plus in a small grey square. Tour: soft on phones, dark frosted glass over a photo on desktop.
notes: the tour variant expects a photo behind it on desktop (it turns into dark glass from lg up)
